lines: Dawnfield. End of the ferry, start of the chapter.
Aeon sent word ahead. Your team is on the list, but the list opens badge by badge. Earn them.
The MochiiPlex here is small, but the heal is free, same as home. Rest before you walk.
npcs.speaker: Ferry captain

lines: Aeon handed you to me by radio, so I will say it plain: this region remembers Rangers.
Walk the opening road first. Do not skip to the tower. The tower notices skippers.
npcs.speaker: Dawnfield researcher (radio handoff from Aeon)

entries.sprites: ferry dock + small town, Kenney Tiny City CC0 restyled

lines: This is the opening road. First wilds, first Rangers, nothing fancy — and that is the point.
If your team feels thin, catch here. The grass is kind to new arrivals.
npcs.speaker: Cherryport road keeper

lines: The water here is shallow. Wave-Ride is not needed yet. Walk the bank and watch the data.
A Ranger who rushes past Cherryport misses the whole region. I have seen it happen.
npcs.speaker: Cherryport fisher

entries.sprites: road + shore, Kenney Tiny Town CC0 restyled

post: You know it. Take the first badge of this region. Your old team opens one slot wider now.
pre: A tower stands because every stone knows its place. Show me you know yours.

entries.music: tower loop, somber, CC0 chiptune; dojo loop tenser, same key

lines: The tower is a puzzle, not a wall. Each floor teaches you one thing. Do not climb angry.
The first beast was seen here. Seen, not caught. Remember the difference.
npcs.speaker: Tower guide

lines: Violet is old. The dojo is older. Respect both and the badge will not feel heavy.
npcs.speaker: Violet town elder

entries.sprites: tower interior, Kenney Furniture Kit CC0 restyled; town, Tiny Town CC0 restyled

lines: The spring flows where we say it flows. You are not on the list.
Fine. Battle me, then. The list does not change, but you can try.
antagonist.speaker: Syndicate operative, at the well

post: Steady. Take the second badge. Your old team opens another slot.
pre: You brought the spring back. Now bring a steady team. I test steadiness, not speed.

entries.music: well loop, low, CC0 chiptune; town loop calm

lines: The well is not dry. It is drained. Someone is taking the spring, one bucket at a time.
Go down. Bring the spring back. The town will remember who did it.
npcs.speaker: Well keeper

entries.sprites: well interior, 0x72 CC0; town, Tiny Town CC0 restyled

lines: The forest is a maze on purpose. The shrine is in the middle, and the middle is quiet.
The second beast was seen at the shrine. It did not stay. Beasts do not stay for crowds.
npcs.speaker: Forest shrine keeper

lines: I got lost here three times. The fourth time, I stopped rushing, and the path found me.
Cut nothing here unless the path asks you to. Data-Cut is a tool, not a shortcut.
npcs.speaker: Forest wanderer

entries.sprites: forest maze, Kenney Tiny Town CC0 restyled

lines: The tower is ours on paper. Paper is stronger than you think.
antagonist.speaker: Syndicate operative, tower lobby

post: Exact. Take the third badge. Your old team opens another slot.
pre: A big city dojo is not a big dojo. It is a dojo that has to be exact, because everyone is watching.

lines: The tower talks to the whole region. Right now it is talking too much, and listening too little.
Come back after the tower story. It will make sense then, and not before.
npcs.speaker: Radio Tower clerk

lines: Big city, big market. The Garden branch here sells what Silicon Town cannot stock yet.
Do not buy everything. Buy what your team actually needs for the next road.
npcs.speaker: Market clerk

entries.sprites: city + tower, Kenney Tiny City CC0 restyled

post: You learned. Take the fourth badge. Your old team opens another slot.
pre: Fire teaches, if you let it. Show me what the tower taught you.

lines: The tower burned, and the beasts woke in the smoke. They are not yours to catch yet.
They are yours to follow. Follow, do not chase. Chasing scares a beast into the next region.
npcs.speaker: Burned Tower keeper

lines: This city remembers fire. It also remembers the Rangers who walked out of the fire calm.
npcs.speaker: Ecruteak elder

entries.sprites: burned tower, 0x72 CC0 + Tiny Town CC0 restyled

post: Patient. Take the fifth badge. Your old team opens another slot.
pre: A lighthouse keeper's dojo is a dojo of patience. Wait for the right move, then take it.

lines: The light is not for ships. It is for Rangers who have forgotten where the shore is.
Keep the light, and I will keep the sea road open for you. That is the deal, and it is fair.
npcs.speaker: Lighthouse keeper

lines: Wave-Ride works here, same as Region 1. Water is a road, if you respect it. Do not surf angry.
npcs.speaker: Olivine harbour keeper

entries.sprites: lighthouse + harbour, Kenney Tiny City CC0 restyled

post: Cared for. Take the sixth badge. Your old team opens another slot.
pre: You crossed water to get here. Now cross the gap between a good team and a cared-for team.

lines: The medicine is not magic. It is care, measured out, one dose at a time. Bring it to the island dojo, and bring it whole.
The water crossing is short. The lesson is long. Do not mix them up.
npcs.speaker: Medicine keeper

entries.sprites: island town, Tiny Town CC0 restyled

lines: The lake is a battery. We charge it, we use it. You are not part of the circuit.
antagonist.speaker: Syndicate hideout leader (role only, NAME GAP for personal name)

post: Calm. Take the seventh badge. Your old team opens another slot.
pre: You calmed a lake. Now calm a dojo. Same skill, smaller water.

lines: The lake is angry. Something red is in it, and it is not red by nature. Someone made it red.
The hideout is under the town. Raid it, and the lake calms. Do not raid it angry — raid it steady.
npcs.speaker: Lake watcher

entries.sprites: lake + hideout, 0x72 CC0 + Tiny Town CC0 restyled

post: The den saw you. Take the eighth badge. Your old team is fully open now.
pre: You walked the den. Now stand in it. Show me the Ranger the den saw.

lines: The den is a trial, not a test. A test asks what you know. A trial asks who you are.
Walk the den. If you come out, the badge is already yours. The battle just confirms it.
npcs.speaker: Den elder

entries.sprites: den + city, 0x72 CC0 + Tiny City CC0 restyled

lines: Eight badges. That is the gate, and it is the only gate. Walk it. Do not run it — run it and you will miss the Rangers who teach you.
npcs.speaker: Victory gate keeper

lines: I have walked this route in Region 1 and here. The route remembers. Show me you do too.
After battle: You remember. Good. The Plateau is next, and it remembers more.
npcs.speaker: Veteran Ranger (talk-to-battle, ROSTER GAP team)

post: You have. The Hall remembers you twice now. Go back and finish what you started in Region 1 — it is waiting, stronger.
pre: You have beaten a region that remembers you. Now beat the Ranger it remembers most.
champion.speaker: CHAMPION — Rin & Ren (twins, joint holders)

pre: I guard the door. Pass me, and you are no longer a visitor.
elite.speaker: ELITE 1 (NAME GAP)

pre: I guard the stairs. Climb, if you can.
elite.speaker: ELITE 2 (NAME GAP)

post: It will remember you. The champion's door is next.
pre: I guard the hall. The hall remembers everyone who stood here.
elite.speaker: ELITE 3 (NAME GAP)

pre: I guard the champion's door. Knock twice, and mean it.
elite.speaker: ELITE 4 (NAME GAP)

entries.music: elite loop, champion loop, hall loop calm, CC0 chiptune

lines: Second ascent. Same Plateau, different Ranger. The Hall has a second page for you, if you earn it.
npcs.speaker: Plateau attendant

entries.sprites: Plateau + Hall, Furniture Kit CC0 restyled

post: The sea route is open. Storm-locked, but open. Region 3 is waiting.
champion.speaker: FIRST CHAMPION — Shimo

entries.kind: post-game final battle, link to Region 3
entries.music: snow loop, quiet, CC0 chiptune; final-battle loop, driving

lines: The top is snow and silence. The First Champion waits there. He does not talk. He battles.
npcs.speaker: Frost Peak guide

lines: You beat the First Champion. The expedition signal is clean. Take the storm route. Region 3 is on the other side of it.
npcs.speaker: Prof. Aeon, radio, after Frost Peak

entries.sprites: snow peak, Tiny Town CC0 restyled + 0x72 CC0
